cross_center_ownership.contract_center_rule: 已确认工程签证可形成合同变更，但不直接修改合同或结算金额

cross_center_ownership.project_center_rule: 项目签证仅作为来源事实；合同变更独立生效后才能形成结算调整
项目中心只展示项目维度工资投影，薪酬主数据与核算规则归行政中心
项目中心只提供项目上下文入口，资金单据与资金核算归财务中心
复用结算对象并增加日常合同来源关系，不新建平行结算模型

release_gates: 每个可见菜单必须绑定已验收 action、路由、权限与公司/项目数据域
NEW_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED 不得以空页面、占位菜单或技术模型直接对业务用户发布
菜单迁移默认保留 XMLID、action、权限与业务语义；破坏性变更需 ADR
验收必须覆盖真实角色、公司、数据库、桌面、平板和移动视口

policy_strategy.authority: native Odoo menu/action facts plus explicit P1 formal-entry selection
policy_strategy.delivery_rule: standard includes formally released entries; preview includes released plus explicitly preview entries; native ACLs remain authoritative for both

excluded_scope.reason: legacy duplicate acceptance carrier, not a formal product center
navigation structure only; delivered through native hierarchy
entered from their owning page rather than duplicated as standalone navigation

policy_strategy.runtime_projection: derived_product_definition; deployment snapshots record versions and are not menu-definition inputs

role_catalog.basis: product default role set, delivered as contract data
role_catalog.delivery_rule: default_roles is the shipped product baseline and is extendable: a runtime may add roles that bind to real res.groups. A role is never an authorization in itself - the delivered authority is always the intersection of the declaration with the principal's real group/record-rule visibility, so a role declaration can never widen access. Every non-synthetic role must bind at least one group xmlid, otherwise it cannot be delivered.
